protocol: trstctl signer-backed break-glass rotation and CA cross-signing
required_interoperability: served CA ceremony and create-root routes bootstrap the persisted signer handle and public certificate without a test-owned registry or private-key export
production buildRunDeps binds configured CA/public material to one persisted purpose-constrained dual-control signer handle
online issue intent is tenant scoped and exact-request digested before authenticated ca.ceremony.approved events are collected
caller-supplied approver names have no quorum power; only distinct immutable event actors in the configured operator roster count
sub-quorum, altered request, cross-tenant request, and consumed-ceremony replay fail closed
rotation creates a fresh signer-held key and self-signed CA while retaining the previous verifier for overlap and rollback
previous-to-new and new-to-previous constrained cross-certificates both carry an independently generated leaf chain under OpenSSL
a fresh production assembly replays the rotated signer handle and issues a leaf chaining to the rotated CA
the active signer cross-signs a CA certificate generated by the independent OpenSSL substrate and OpenSSL validates a substrate leaf through that cross-certificate
signer-backed authority cross-sign and offline-root re-key/cross-sign import routes carry public certificates only and their returned/imported paths validate independently generated leaves
no private key material enters an HTTP request, response, event, or control-plane transcript
